name: codex-session-renderer
description: Browser-first Codex session browser with export and VS Code integration.

commands.title: Codex Session Renderer: Open Session Browser
Codex Session Renderer: Open Latest Preview
Codex Session Renderer: Copy Browser URL
Codex Session Renderer: Run Developer Self-Check

codexSessionRenderer.host.description: Host used for the local session browser server.

codexSessionRenderer.port.description: Preferred port for the local session browser server. Use 0 to select a free port.

codexSessionRenderer.openMode.description: How the session browser is opened. The first version always uses the external browser.

codexSessionRenderer.sessionsDir.description: Optional override for the sessions directory.

codexSessionRenderer.archivedSessionsDir.description: Optional override for the archived sessions directory.

codexSessionRenderer.clientHeartbeatTime.description: Minutes a browser client may miss heartbeats before the extension forgets its client record. This never stops the server; closing the last browser page still does.

codexSessionRenderer.showDeveloperComman.description: Show developer-only diagnostic commands such as the internal self-check.
